1. [I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in] my [God;] for He has clothed me with the garments of salvation,  
  2. [He has covered me with the robe of victory, as a bridegroom puts on a priestly] diadem, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
  3. [So the Lord God will cause victory and gl]ory [to spring forth.] May the groom be blessed the blessing of
  4. [... ha]ppiness and rejoicing and fulfillment of requests
  5. [...] from her husband like Elkanah and a double blessing
  6. [...] and may they have length of years. And may she be blessed like Yael
  7. [...] and may he merit to see the completion of the Temple. And may she give birth to sons
  8. [... like Pe]ninnah. Bridegroom and bride. They built and prospered, the two of them
  9. [...] our masters built and prospered. On the third day
  10. [... da]ys in the month Av, which is one thousand, ⟦ninety⟧
  11. [... and] six years, of the era to which we are accustomed in the city
  12. [... which is lo]cated [on the sea], with the tongue of the Stream of Egypt called the Nile on top of it.
  13. [...] “I, [... sai]id, intentionally, voluntarily, and of my own choice, not
  14. [coerced ... not in]toxicated, to take as my wife Dalāl 
  15. [... with intention] to nourish, provide for, clothe  
  16. [... in the manner of] Jewish men, who nourish 
  17. [... and hon]or [their] wiv[es], faithfully.  
  18. [...] daughter of the ... Japheth, and she desired
  19. [...] in the manner of respectable wives  
  20. [...] their [hus]bands, faithfully.
